title: Contact Veteran John Outreach
body: We're here to listen, help, and connect. Whether you have a question, want to get involved, or need support, we'd love to hear from you.

blocks.title: How Can We Help
blocks.subtitle: Choose the option that best describes why you're reaching out.

deck.title: I need information
deck.subtitle: Learn more about our programs, events, and how we help veterans.

deck.title: I Want to Volunteer
deck.subtitle: Find out how you can give your time and make a difference.

deck.title: I Want to Partner
deck.subtitle: Explore partnership opportunities, sponsorships, or community collaborations.

deck.title: General Question
deck.subtitle: Have another question? We're happy to help.
